title: Live: Russia says Ukrainian drones struck Black Sea port, Rubio to visit eastern Europe

contentText: A Ukrainian drone attack damaged Russia's Taman port, sparking a fire at the strategic Black Sea hub, local officials said Sunday. The reported attack comes as US Secretary of State Marco Rubio begins a two-day trip to Slovakia and Hungary, whose conservative leaders have warm ties with President Donald Trump – but have resisted pressure to quit Russian oil. Follow our blog for the latest developments.
